b22617cae7e23e485813437173e8df2c35b2abbc is the last commit on this lane that changes anything outside docs/06_status/proof/UTV2-1889/. It supersedes f767e81abc77b7952afe88204827e84668f41952, which was this field's value while the journey proof still failed on nine of its own assertions and while gaps A, B and D were reported rather than repaired. That anchor is moved rather than its claim reworded: the anchor carried a binding claim -- 'every later commit touches only the proof directory' -- and the repair commit falsified it by changing source in apps/ingestor and apps/api. A binding rule that has been falsified is not repaired by restating it.
The lane's source-changing commits are now: 4701685541dfc537ee46b3fdc0b41fe3819d5554 (the original seven files), ba24e12158a84d314ecba228c536944c586bac9d (the lane-PR binding commit CI wrote, touching only the manifest), 2b0a01e02a6a4c887496e79eb66622cc2b38f7ef (the cross-file coupling test), f767e81abc77b7952afe88204827e84668f41952 (the SGO journey proof, which at that head reported four gaps), and b22617cae7e23e485813437173e8df2c35b2abbc, which repairs gaps A, B and D in apps/ingestor/src/results-resolver.ts and drives the journey proof to 50/50. The proof commit carrying this file sits on top and changes nothing the assertions are about.

unit_tests.label: The stats aggregate, the report adapter, the operator-attest CLI, the --help anti-drift control, the writer/reader coupling assertion, and the ten integrated SGO journey tests added at b22617cae7e23e485813437173e8df2c35b2abbc. The journey tests run the real SGO parser (fetchSGOResults with an injected fetchImpl, so the provider is never contacted), the real resolveAndInsertResults, the real processSubmission, the real runGradingPass and the real computeTrackOnlyStats against seeded participants, events and event_participants -- normalization, persistence, grading and stats through the shipped code rather than a restatement of it. 9 pre-existing tests in this file are untouched.

Moneyline grading, the result-market-key guard, provider-keyed provenance, and the composed Track Only + operator + moneyline journey. The 71 pre-existing tests are the population UTV2-1886 left green and all still pass.

The gap A/B/D repair, asserted on the resolver itself. The five new tests pin: a moneyline writes one row per side keyed game_moneyline_win with the team's participant_id and a value in {1,0} (and assert directly that neither raw score, 5 or 3, reaches an outcome-keyed row); a tie writes 0.5 on both sides; a half-scored event writes NOTHING and counts skippedMoneylineOutcomeUnresolved; an event with no event_participants rows -- the exact shape of the 3,000+ historical game-line rows -- writes NOTHING and counts skippedTeamSideUnresolved; and a game total is untouched by the moneyline path. The 4 pre-existing UTV2-1287 telemetry tests are unchanged and still pass.

The ingestor suite, including test 76 ('results-resolver canonical alias maps include expanded player props and game lines'), which was the one collateral failure of the gap A repair and is the reason it is recorded here. It asserted the sixteen <league>-<bet>-all-game aliases that gap A removed as unreachable by construction. It was not deleted: it now asserts the two keys normalizeSgoProviderMarketKey can actually emit AND that three of the removed keys resolve to undefined, so silently re-adding an unreachable alias fails. The 28 player-prop alias assertions above it are untouched.

The whole wired ops suite, 21 files, 64.6s, run at this head. Recorded because the journey tests live in the already-wired scripts/ops/track-only-report.test.ts rather than a new file -- pnpm verify fails closed with WIRING_TEST_UNWIRED_NEW on an unwired scripts/ test, and root package.json is outside this lane's file_scope_lock.

production_measurement.note: The cohort predicate is `metadata ? 'distributionMode'` and it returns exactly one row: Griff's Milestone 1 pick dfcd9486-cba2-4bb5-b684-beec36e52c0b. Two of these numbers decide a design choice rather than describe the world. 280 rows under `points-all-game-ml` carry a raw score and ZERO of them carry a participant_id, so no side is attached and the number's meaning is ambiguous -- which is why the attested win flag gets the dedicated key `game_moneyline_win` instead. And there are ZERO rows under that dedicated key today, so this change makes no pre-existing row newly interpretable: it can only read a result an operator writes after it lands. The 0 outbox rows are the containment observation, and this lane adds no path to a non-zero value.

coverage_gap.statement: The staging job exercises none of this lane's changed paths, and this lane deliberately wires no twentieth live suite. A live suite here would have to seed its own events, event_participants and game_results rows under market_key game_moneyline_win -- and production holds zero such rows against 280 points-all-game-ml rows with no participant_id -- so the suite would prove that the seed it just wrote can be read back, not that the journey works. What replaced it at b22617cae7e23e485813437173e8df2c35b2abbc is an INTEGRATED in-process journey: the real SGO parser, the real resolver, the real submission path, the real grading pass and the real stats aggregate, composed end to end against the in-memory repositories. That is a genuine integration claim and it is still not a live-database claim, which is why this gap stays OPEN rather than being narrowed by the journey tests.
coverage_gap.why_that_is_the_honest_position_and_not_: The live suites exist to prove that a real driver behaves as the in-memory one is assumed to. The three code paths here make no new database call and no new query shape: grading reads `game_results` through the same repository method it already used, and the stats aggregate is a pure function over rows the report already fetched with `select: '*'`. What WOULD need live proof is a result actually written under `game_moneyline_win` -- and there are zero such rows in production or staging, because writing one is an operator action under DB_ENVIRONMENT_OPERATOR_POLICY.md that this lane deliberately does not perform. Claiming live coverage by seeding a row would prove the seed, not the journey.

What remains unproven is the database round trip, and the honest way to close it is a real operator attestation against a real event -- an operator action under DB_ENVIRONMENT_OPERATOR_POLICY.md, not an agent one.

runtime_proof.binding_rule:
REBOUND and RECEIPTED at bdc03146e2b9745b8abe2d61a73d191eac266c03, 2026-09-12. The previously cited run (34651506561, head 7dd4ccb69) is NOT VALID for this bundle and stays withdrawn: it compiled the tree at 2b0a01e02, and two later commits change source on top of it -- f767e81abc77b7952afe88204827e84668f41952 (the journey proof) and b22617cae7e23e485813437173e8df2c35b2abbc (the gap A/B/D repair). A receipt for a superseded source tree is not weaker evidence, it is evidence for a different artifact.
The replacement is run 34690701925 at bdc03146e, cited only after it CONCLUDED. That ordering is not fussiness: the staging DB proof job serialises through a concurrency group, so a new push CANCELS the run in progress, and the act of committing a citation to an in-flight run is what invalidates it. This lane already paid for that lesson once (run 34650795093 went green on its staging job and was then cancelled during `verify` by the very push carrying its citation). The loop terminated by citing a finished run.
The head-independent claim, restated in its source-tree form after a `main` resync widened the file list: b22617cae7e23e485813437173e8df2c35b2abbc is the last commit on this lane that touches SOURCE. The earlier wording said every commit after it touches only docs/06_status/proof/UTV2-1889/, and the resync merge b015c3ea6292a31d2e22515e38aff8a98d23ca46 made that literally false by bringing docs/06_status/readiness/readiness-score.json onto the branch from `main`. The claim is corrected by moving to the predicate that actually carries the evidence rather than by rewording a falsified one: `git diff --name-only b22617cae7e23e485813437173e8df2c35b2abbc b015c3ea6 -- 'apps/**' 'packages/**' 'scripts/**' 'supabase/**' '.github/**'` returns EMPTY, so bdc03146e and every later head on this lane compile a source tree byte-identical to b22617cae's. The full diff at b015c3ea6 is exactly three docs paths: this file, verification.md, and the readiness ledger the bot maintains.
`verify` and `Writable DB proof (staging only)` green on the MERGE SHA is asserted separately by closeout check G6, which is where the route B deferral is actually enforced.
